name: bill-reader

dependencies.name: expense-api
dependencies.description: Reads the category list so the suggested category is one that exists.

description: Reads one bill (JPG, PNG or PDF, attached to the message) and answers with the amount, currency, date, merchant and a suggested category, or an empty result when it cannot read the bill. It is an agent because reading an image is model work. It saves nothing and may only read categories; the member confirms in the web app.
